subject: Transportation Systems
title: Bus Network Design
description: A quick, practical guide to Bus Network Design.

hook.text: Most bus networks evolved randomly over decades. Redesigning them from scratch can double ridership.

buildup.text: Houston redesigned its entire bus network in 2015. Same budget, same buses—just better routes.

discovery.text: They shifted from coverage—serving everywhere poorly—to frequency on popular corridors.

twist.text: Some neighborhoods lost direct service. The political backlash was fierce, even as overall ridership rose.

climax.text: Weekend ridership jumped 30%. Riders chose frequent service over nearby-but-infrequent routes.

punchline.text: Riders don't want coverage. They want a bus coming soon.

quiz.question: What did Houston's bus network redesign prioritize?
options: Frequency on popular corridors over broad coverage
